changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Historico inmutable de la incidencia (ARC-118): traza append-only de alta, cambio de estado, asignacion, reclasificacion y comentario de resolucion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE incidencia_historico ( history_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, incident_id NUMBER NOT NULL, entry_type VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) NOT NULL, from_status VARCHAR2(20 CHAR), to_status VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, previous_room_id NUMBER, new_room_id NUMBER, previous_category_id NUMBER, new_category_id NUMBER, previous_technician_id NUMBER, assigned_technician_id NUMBER, assigned_technician_name VARCHAR2(150 CHAR), actor_user_id NUMBER NOT NULL, actor_display_name VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) NOT NULL, changed_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, entry_comment VARCHAR2(500 CHAR), resolution_comment_ref NUMBER, previous_entry_hash VARCHAR2(64 CHAR), entry_hash VARCHAR2(64 CHAR) NOT NULL, value_before GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE entry_type WHEN 'RECLASIFICACION' THEN SUBSTR('room_id=' || previous_room_id || ';category_id=' || previous_category_id, 1, 200) WHEN 'ASIGNACION' THEN SUBSTR('assigned_technician_id=' || previous_technician_id, 1, 200) ELSE CAST(from_status AS VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)) END) VIRTUAL, value_after GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE entry_type WHEN 'RECLASIFICACION' THEN SUBSTR('room_id=' || new_room_id || ';category_id=' || new_category_id, 1, 200) WHEN 'ASIGNACION' THEN SUBSTR('assigned_technician_id=' || assigned_technician_id, 1, 200) ELSE CAST(to_status AS VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)) END) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_incidencia_historico PRIMARY KEY (history_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_incidencia FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidencia (incident_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_from_status FOREIGN KEY (from_status) REFERENCES cat_estado_incidencia (status_code), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_to_status FOREIGN KEY (to_status) REFERENCES cat_estado_incidencia (status_code), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_prev_room FOREIGN KEY (previous_room_id) REFERENCES cat_sala (room_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_new_room FOREIGN KEY (new_room_id) REFERENCES cat_sala (room_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_prev_category FOREIGN KEY (previous_category_id) REFERENCES cat_categoria_incidencia (category_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_new_category FOREIGN KEY (new_category_id) REFERENCES cat_categoria_incidencia (category_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_prev_tecnico FOREIGN KEY (previous_technician_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_tecnico FOREIGN KEY (assigned_technician_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_actor FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_inc_hist_resolucion_ref FOREIGN KEY (resolution_comment_ref) REFERENCES incidencia (incident_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Reglas de coherencia del historico: tipos de asiento, apertura de la traza, inmovilidad del estado en la asignacion, referencia de resolucion y formato de la cadena de huellas
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_from_status_creacion CHECK ( (entry_type = 'CREACION' AND from_status IS NULL) OR (entry_type <> 'CREACION' AND from_status IS NOT NULL) )
ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_asignacion CHECK ( entry_type <> 'ASIGNACION' OR (from_status = to_status AND assigned_technician_id IS NOT NULL) )

ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_resolucion_ref CHECK ( (from_status = 'RESUELTA' AND to_status = 'CERRADA' AND resolution_comment_ref = incident_id) OR ((from_status IS NULL OR from_status <> 'RESUELTA' OR to_status <> 'CERRADA') AND resolution_comment_ref IS NULL) )

ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_previous_hash CHECK ( (entry_type = 'CREACION' AND previous_entry_hash IS NULL) OR (entry_type <> 'CREACION' AND REGEXP_LIKE(previous_entry_hash, '^[0-9A-F]{64}$')) )

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_previous_hash
ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_entry_hash
ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_resolucion_ref
ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_asignacion
ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_creacion_abierta
ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_from_status_creacion
ALTER TABLE incidencia_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inc_hist_entry_type

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indices de acceso del historico y invariantes de unicidad: un unico asiento de alta y un unico asiento de cierre por incidencia
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_inc_hist_incident_changed ON incidencia_historico (incident_id, changed_at, history_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_inc_hist_actividad ON incidencia_historico (changed_at DESC, history_id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_inc_hist_creacion ON incidencia_historico (CASE WHEN entry_type = 'CREACION' THEN incident_id END)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_inc_hist_cierre ON incidencia_historico (CASE WHEN from_status = 'RESUELTA' AND to_status = 'CERRADA' THEN incident_id END)
